items.title: Integration risk with vs. without a translation layer
items.description: A toy model, not real company data. It shows a simple idea: if five systems depend directly on Sales' internal Order shape, one Sales change can create five places to fix. With one translation layer, that change is handled in one place. Drag 'downstream consumers' up and watch the gap between the two lines widen.
items.compute: const directRisk = params.numDownstreamConsumers * params.upstreamChangesPerQuarter; const aclRisk = params.upstreamChangesPerQuarter; return { directRisk, aclRisk };

outputs.label: Updates needed, with a translation layer
